title: Cancelling Plans
description: Practise linking words, the past simple and "going to", then write an email cancelling plans with a friend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I can't come to the cinema ___ I have a bad cold.
exercises.explanation: "Because" introduces the reason: I have a bad cold.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ (wake) up with a terrible headache this morning.
exercises.explanation: "Wake" is irregular: wake - woke.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I am going to stay at home.
Am I going to stay at home?
exercises.explanation: Subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb: I am going to stay at home.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Can we meet in Saturday instead?
answers: Can we meet on Saturday instead?
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.explanation: Past simple negative: didn't + base verb: I didn't feel.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.explanation: "Bad" has an irregular comparative: bad - worse - worst.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I'm sorry. I ___ call you tomorrow, I promise.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb for promises and offers: I will call you tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: The doctor ___ (tell) me to rest for two days.
exercises.explanation: "Tell" is irregular: tell - told.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I went to bed early last night.
Last night I went to bed early.
exercises.explanation: "Go" is irregular: go - went. Time expressions like "last night" can go at the start or the end.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I catched a cold at the weekend.
answers: I caught a cold at the weekend.
exercises.explanation: "Catch" is irregular: catch - caught.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: When you phoned, I ___ in bed.
exercises.explanation: We use the past continuous for an action in progress when something else happened. With "I" we use "was": I was lying.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "much" or "many".
exercises.explanation: "Energy" is uncountable, so we use "much", especially in negative sentences.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + will + base verb: I will phone you later. We use "will" for promises.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Yesterday was the most bad day of the week.
answers: Yesterday was the worst day of the week.
exercises.explanation: "Bad" has an irregular superlative: bad - worse - the worst.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: Have you got ___ plans for next weekend?
exercises.explanation: We usually use "any" in questions with plural or uncountable nouns: Have you got any plans?

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Don't worry. I'm sure you ___ (have) a great time without me.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb for predictions, often after "I'm sure".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I really wanted to come, but I can't.
I can't, but I really wanted to come.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two contrasting ideas: I wanted to come, but I can't.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I were in bed all day yesterday.
answers: I was in bed all day yesterday.
exercises.explanation: With "I", "he", "she" and "it" we use "was" in the past: I was.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I have a fever, ___ my mum says I must stay in bed.
exercises.explanation: "So" introduces a result: I have a fever (reason), so I must stay in bed (result).

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The doctor gave me some advices.
answers: The doctor gave me some advice.
exercises.explanation: "Advice" is uncountable, so it has no plural -s: some advice.

task.prompt: You planned to go to the cinema with your friend Ben tonight, but you are ill. Write an email to him.
contentPoints: Say sorry and say which plan you are cancelling.
End the email in a friendly way.
usefulLanguage: I'm really sorry, but I can't ...
task.modelAnswer:
Hi Ben,

I'm really sorry, but I can't come to the cinema with you this evening. I woke up with a bad cold this morning, and I feel worse now. My mum says I should stay in bed. Can we go on Saturday instead? There is a new film about space, and I think it's going to be great.

I hope you understand. See you soon!

Best wishes,
Chris
